title: Structural / Relative-Value / Coherent Surface Atlas

DATA-001.role: 2026 as-of book midpoint, book trades, fills and executable book diagnostics where present
limitations: archive receive time is not project possession time

DATA-002.role: economic fill/price stream and generic same-event family census across five families
DATA-002.economic_print_identity: deduplicate outcome_side=YES on (family, token_id, tx_hash); inconsistent duplicate prices fail closed
limitations: US_2024/CAN_2025 have no fee-role meaning pre-fee; fees are not used by 005D

inventory_policy.UNKNOWN: anything lacking sufficient semantic proof or stable metadata; fail closed
inventory_policy.hard_edge_gate: explicit semantic proof/accepted audited family only; same event_id or title similarity is never sufficient
inventory_policy.generic_event_groups: SOFT and LOO-PRICE/reconstruction-only until semantic audit proves the leakage class
inventory_policy.yes_no_same_market: HARD complement but DIRECT_EQUIVALENT; eligible for reconstruction diagnostics only and excluded from LOO-FAMILY

calibrated: error-correction residual from the frozen TRAIN mapping
coherent: bid/ask interval diagnostic where DATA-001 book evidence exists
soft/slack projection lambda={0.25,1.0,4.0} for SOFT constraints only
seat_chamber: independence baseline when exact constituent-to-count topology is proven
one-factor logistic challenger when target-excluded race topology is proven
joint-market-implied dependence when exact joint semantics are proven
leave-one-race inverse structural objective when topology is proven
graph: explicit audited INDIRECT-edge target-excluded ridge graph
hard deterministic factors plus soft statistical factors; no generic reduced-rank panel model

leakage_modes.LOO-PRICE: target direct quote removed; mechanically equivalent/sibling information may remain; reconstruction diagnostic
leakage_modes.LOO-FAMILY: target, direct equivalent, complement, duplicate, NegRisk/mechanical sibling and other direct information family removed; clean indirect-alpha lane

targets.economic_trade_definition: unique deduplicated target-token economic print in DATA-001 books/trades or DATA-002 (token_id,tx_hash)

splits.method: per structural family × stream chronological 60/20/20 by timestamp span
splits.holdout_rule: phase-1 may inspect identity/activity metadata and load source files, but HOLDOUT price/target rows are masked before any feature fitting, scoring, aggregation, logging or output; phase-2 requires an immutable shortlist hash
splits.small_support: cells with fewer than 100 valid target observations in TRAIN or 50 in DEV are UNAVAILABLE, not rescued by changing splits

train_discovery.allowed: broad descriptive census and TRAIN-only fitting
train_discovery.claim_policy: TRAIN discoveries are never called alpha

dev_selection.primary_statistic: signed response toward frozen fair value / coherent repair after own-target-lag and broad-event controls
survival_rules: declared DEV statistic finite with predeclared direction
BH q <= 0.10 within declared family OR reconstruction RMSE improves by >=5% for RECONSTRUCTION_ONLY
same sign in both DEV halves when each half has >=25 observations
not entirely dependent on one target market (>70% absolute score contribution)
delayed-state or block-shift control does not reproduce >=80% of the observed absolute effect
LOO-FAMILY survivor remains after direct/mechanical family exclusion

holdout.pass_policy: report evidence; do not auto-promote to live trading. A model deserves tournament entry only if effect direction survives, uncertainty excludes zero for its primary score, controls do not explain it, and scope is honestly labelled.

methods: M-019 depth-aware max-min LP when depth exists

researcher_discretion: only before this freeze; post-freeze changes require explicit amendment and invalidate untouched-holdout status for affected cells
